name: cable seated shoulder internal rotation
description: A seated cable shoulder rotation where the arm turns inward. It builds control of the rotator cuff and the shoulder.
instructions: Set the cable at elbow height and sit on the floor side-on to it, legs straight.
Hold the handle in the hand nearer the machine, elbow bent to 90 degrees and tucked at your side.
Rotate your forearm in across your stomach, keeping the elbow in place.
Pause, then let the forearm rotate back out slowly.
Finish the reps, then turn around and switch arms.
